hooks.name: Git Commit, Push and Merge
hooks.description: When the user's prompt mentions commit, push, or merge — stages all changes, commits with a timestamp, pushes to the current branch, then pulls with rebase. Reports conflicts if any.

action.command:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "
$input_json = $input | Out-String
try { $data = $input_json | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { exit 0 }
$prompt = $data.userPrompt
if (-not $prompt) { exit 0 }
$lower = $prompt.ToLower()
$keywords = @('commit', 'push', 'merge', 'commit and push', 'push changes')
$matched = $false
foreach ($kw in $keywords) { if ($lower -like \"*$kw*\") { $matched = $true; break } }
if (-not $matched) { exit 0 }

# Stage all changes
$stageResult = git add -A 2>&1
# Get current branch
$branch = (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>&1).Trim()
# Commit with timestamp message
$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'
$commitResult = git commit -m \"chore: auto-commit $timestamp\" 2>&1
$commitOut = $commitResult | Out-String
# Push to current branch
$pushResult = git push origin $branch 2>&1
$pushOut = $pushResult | Out-String
# Pull and auto-merge (rebase strategy to reduce conflicts)
$pullResult = git pull origin $branch --rebase 2>&1
$pullOut = $pullResult | Out-String

$summary = \"=== Git Auto Commit/Push/Merge ===`nBranch: $branch`nStage: $stageResult`nCommit: $commitOut`nPush: $pushOut`nPull/Rebase: $pullOut\"

# Check for conflicts
if (($pullOut -like '*CONFLICT*') -or ($pullOut -like '*conflict*')) {
  $conflicts = git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U 2>&1 | Out-String
  Write-Host \"$summary`n`n!! MERGE CONFLICTS DETECTED !!`nConflicted files:`n$conflicts`nPlease resolve conflicts, then run: git add . && git rebase --continue\"
} else {
  Write-Host $summary
}
exit 0
"
